check_structure_shapes: check that a PyTree of arrays matches a pattern of ArraySpec leaves with dimension variables
create_var_dimension: create a dimension variable with var() that can be matched against array shapes in a pattern
extract_array_structure: extract an ArraySpec tree from a concrete PyTree of arrays using as_array_structure
get_dimension_variables: get all dimension variables from a structure containing ArraySpec leaves
substitute_dimension_variables: substitute all dimension variables in a structure with their known concrete values
